title: KoreLumina — Master OS - KoreLumina Reconstruction Plan — message 4

metadata.content:
This is the direction I would take. The key difference is that we are not pausing KoreLumina implementation. We are implementing a foundational platform that every subsequent phase will use.
KoreLumina Handoff — Phase 0: Knowledge Platform ImplementationMissionArchitecture V1 has been frozen.Implementation has officially begun.Before continuing the Universal Runtime roadmap, we will implement the Knowledge Platform (KP).This is not an AI model.This is the permanent knowledge infrastructure that will eventually power the KoreLumina Engineering Agent.The objective is for KoreLumina to begin learning from its own implementation from day one.VisionKoreLumina should become a self-improving Software Operating System.Every engineering activity should become reusable knowledge.The Knowledge Platform becomes the institutional memory of the platform.Future AI capabilities will consume this knowledge rather than relying solely on prompts.Guiding PrincipleWe are not training an AI.We are building the infrastructure required to train and operate an AI in the future.Every repository imported.Every architecture document.Every runtime event.Every engineering task.Every implementation.Every deployment.Every accepted AI draft.Every bug.Every fix.Every decision.becomes structured knowledge.Platform ArchitectureThe Knowledge Platform becomes a first-class platform.KoreLumina PlatformsUniversal RuntimeRepository Intelligence PlatformAI PlatformKnowledge PlatformCustomer Experience PlatformDeployment PlatformEnterprise PlatformAutonomous Operations PlatformEngineering PlatformPlatform Extension FrameworkThe Knowledge Platform serves every other platform.It owns knowledge.It does not own execution.Execution remains the responsibility of the Universal Runtime.Phase 0 RoadmapKP-001Knowledge Store FoundationKP-002Architecture Knowledge IngestionKP-003Repository Knowledge EngineKP-004Runtime Knowledge EngineKP-005Engineering MemoryKP-006Decision MemoryKP-007Knowledge GraphKP-008Semantic SearchKP-009Context BuilderKP-010Learning PipelineOnly after KP-010 is complete should model fine-tuning be considered.Implementation RulesThe Knowledge Platform must not modify production behavior.It operates as an observer.It records.Indexes.Relates.Learns.Existing Runtime behavior must remain unchanged.KP-001 — Knowledge Store directory is the root of KoreLumina's long-term memory.KP-002 — Architecture KnowledgeImport every Architecture V1 document.ParseSectionsResponsibilitiesContractsPrinciplesEntitiesRelationshipsStore them as structured knowledge.The AI should never need to re-read Markdown to answer architectural questions.KP-003 — Repository KnowledgeWhen a repository is imported:GenerateRepository KnowledgeCapture Runtime lifecycle events.ExamplesProject RegisteredRuntime StartedRuntime ReadyPort AllocatedPreview StartedCrashRestartRecoveryShutdownPersist every event.Runtime history becomes searchable.KP-005 — Engineering MemoryEvery engineering ticket produces structured knowledge.Each ticket recordsIdentifierObjectiveArchitecture ReferenceFiles ChangedReasonImplementationValidationCommitOutcomeThis becomes KoreLumina's engineering memory.KP-006 — Decision MemoryEvery Architecture Decision Record.Every engineering decision.Every design trade-off.Every approved exception.becomes queryable knowledge.KP-007 — Knowledge GraphRepresent knowledge as connected entities.ExamplesRepository↓Project↓Runtime↓Deployment↓Issue↓Commit↓ADR↓Specification↓Architecture↓Engineer↓ConversationEverything is connected.The graph becomes the primary navigation ContextEngineering ContextDecision ContextRelevant FilesRecent ChangesThe Context Builder determines what information is presented to an LLM.KP-010 — Learning PipelineOnly after sufficient engineering history exists.CollectAccepted implementationsRejected implementationsHuman correctionsSuccessful fixesRuntime recoveriesEngineering decisionsValidation resultsThese datasets become candidates for future fine-tuning.No model training occurs during Phase 0.Current Engineering RulesOne ticket at a time.Investigate before changing code.Compare implementation against Architecture V1.Small atomic changes.Build after every change.Validate after every change.No speculative refactoring.No architectural drift.Knowledge Platform observes implementation.It does not alter implementation.Success CriteriaBy the end of Phase 0:Every architecture document is indexed.Every repository is understood.Every engineering task is recorded.Every runtime event is stored.Every implementation decision is traceable.Every future AI interaction can consume structured engineering knowledge.The platform begins accumulating proprietary engineering intelligence from the very first implementation ticket.After Phase 0Resume the Implementation Roadmap.Continue with:RT-002 — Runtime Project Registry ContractThen proceed sequentially through the Universal Runtime roadmap.The Knowledge Platform continues running in parallel, silently learning from every engineering activity without interrupting implementation.The long-term objective is to create a KoreLumina Engineering Agent whose expertise is built on the platform's own architecture, codebase, runtime behavior, and engineering history rather than on prompts alone.
